LOS Module

Complete Borrower Journey — 6 Stages.

Register & CKYC
OTP onboarding. CKYC fetch from CKYCR (CERSAI). PAN/Aadhaar verification. Returning user login. Auto-population of name, address, PAN, DOB across application.
CKYC API14-digit IDRBI Mandated
Lead → Basic Application
Project intent, loan category (Solar/Wind/Hybrid/Thermal/Transmission/Hydro/Misc/Non-Capex), entity type capture. Borrower, project & loan data auto-populated from lead.
8 Loan TypesState/Private
Preliminary Appraisal
Instant eligibility computation for Solar/Wind/Hybrid (private borrowers). Transaction fee calculation. Auto-populated from application data. Real-time validation.
Rules EngineInstant Calc
Parallel Review (Innovation)
Legal Team: Title search, security docs review, MOA drafting — simultaneously with — Project Team: Technical appraisal, cost & viability check, environment clearance. 25–30 days → 12–15 days.
50% Faster TATParallel Workflow
Auto Sanction Letter
All fields auto-populated: borrower name, sanctioned amount, loan type, interest rate, tenure, conditions. Digital-signature ready. PDF generation. Committee resolution linkage.
Auto-GenerationDigital Signature
Maker-Checker at Every Stage
Creator → Approver dual control at every stage. Full timestamp trail. Email alerts on each step. Client acceptance workflow. RBI audit-ready from Day 1.
